title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
summary: Physical AI models are advancing beyond single video sources to incorporate multiple camera angles, dense annotations, and potentially brain wave data to improve training and interactions.
content: Forget YouTube videos—frontier physical AI models need multiple camera angles, dense annotation, and soon, brain wave readings.

zh.title: 脑波是物理人工智能的下一个突破口吗？
zh.summary: 物理人工智能模型正在从单一视频源发展到包含多个摄像机角度、密集注释以及可能的脑波数据，以改进训练和交互。
